Create a single character portrait.

NON-NEGOTIABLE (DO NOT INCLUDE):
- text
- labels
- HUD
- overlays
- duplicate subjects
- extra limbs
- fused fingers
- wrong background
- stylization drift.

If any requirement conflicts, follow NON-NEGOTIABLE first.

SUBJECT DEFINITION
- Generate this character exactly: Stylized Cartoon studio style, Modern 3D Animation & Soft Lighting, A full body character portrait
- Apply this style direction exactly: 

COMPOSITION
- One subject only.
- Solid black studio background.
- No text, no labels, no HUD, no overlays.
